subject: MCUPM probe result: firmware present (TASK_STA=INIT), running unproven; CPUHVFS = mailbox 1
body:
MCUPM probe interpretation (README-0107-design.md section 11, host analysis only, no device ops): firmware PRESENT and past early init, RUNNING not proven.
- mbox3 +0x20 = 1 is the firmware TASK_STA slot (vendor mtk_lp_plat_apmcu_mbox.h: mailbox 3 slot 8, 1 = INIT). The stock Image's mtk_wait_mbox_init_done polls exactly this slot until it reads 1, then writes mbox3 slots 7, 6, 4 and later AP_READY. Slots 0..19 of mbox3 zero = AP-owned defaults still untouched, i.e. firmware initialised and waiting for the AP. Noise cannot do that (about 2^-640). mbox4 slots 12..15 (time-sync block) and slot 9 zero likewise deliberate.
- CPUHVFS IPI = id 1 = mailbox 1: send 4 words at 0x1031fd80, doorbell = bit 1 written to 0x10300154, reply 4 words at 0x1031fdd0 flagged by bit 1 of 0x10300078 (clear via 0x10300074). Send half of each mailbox = bytes 0x00..0x4f, receive half from 0x50. Decoded from the stock tables and the vendor source in work/nord2-current-kernel (mcupm_ipi_table.h, mtk-mbox.c).
- Zero SRAM head = cleared region, not proof of absence (power-up noise is high entropy); MCUPM_ACCESS_DRAM_SUPPORT=0 so the code is in the SRAM, somewhere beyond the first 256 bytes.
- Running unproven: all four control registers 0; a halted core looks identical; INIT could even persist from an earlier boot (SRAM retention).
- Safety: PWR_CTRL_EN = AP_READY = 0 so the firmware is not managing MCUSYS/buck/ARMPLL; a bad ping can at worst kill MCUPM until the next boot, CPUs unaffected.
- Stock order needs PLT_INIT with the 2 MiB mcupm_share DRAM region (address chosen by the bootloader) before any DVFS IPI: on the critical path of stage 3.
NEXT (needs its own approval, not built): read-only probe n2mcu=2 = whole 47 KiB SRAM window + 13.5 KiB gap as an entropy map, second snapshot at boot+180 s for a liveness diff, and a mbox3/mbox4/control-register time series. Stage-2 ping ({0xdead,0,0} to mailbox 0, bit 0 of 0x10300154, poll bit 0 of 0x10300078 max 20 ms) only if that shows activity or a recognisable image.
